text: {"label":"Increasing Children's Physical Activity","definition":"Assessment and intervention research on increasing moderate-to-vigorous physical activity in children, including those with developmental disabilities, using reinforcement, adult attention, peers, goal setting, feedback, and activity-context manipulations.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on children's physical activity levels, unlike the adult exercise and health focus of 191 and the general pediatric treatment, care, and early intervention work in 133 and 155."}
